contract: Save progress 0..99 describes preparation; return marks atomic file publication. UI successful completion sets 100. There are no callbacks or cancellation checks after replacement. Once final cancellation check passes and replacement succeeds, a later Cancel does not undo/hide the file. Filesystem errors before replacement preserve destination; failed staging cleans its temp file. No fallback weakens atomic replacement. No fsync/power-loss durability or latency budget claim.
limits: Cancellation between bounded models/cells/output chunks, not inside a model codec or OS write/move. Resource caps, package/world formats and city admission unchanged.
